read_before_measuring.r0_1: NEMO's stage-3 tracer program, from the COMPILED arm GYRE runs (cfgs/GYRE_OMIP_L2_P3_SM_R29ZDF/BLD/ppsrc/nemo/stprk3_stg.f90): tra_adv at :640, tra_sbc_RK3 at :646, tra_qsr at :712, tra_ldf at :727, tra_zdf at :741.  tra_zdf performs the time integration itself; there is no separate stage-3 tracer update.
read_before_measuring.r0_2: tra_zdf (src/OCE/TRA/trazdf.F90:51-115) does three things: it calls tra_zdf_imp('TRA', rDt, ...) at :82, then applies the DRAKKAR negative-salinity clamp at :89-91, then optionally saves trends.  The clamp is ACTIVE on GYRE: it is guarded by .NOT.(ln_SEOS .AND. rn_b0==0) and ln_SEOS = F (round29 ocean.output:158).  So NEMO's existing stage-3 tracer record holds the POST-clamp column, and any pre-clamp comparison needs a new dump.
read_before_measuring.r0_3: tra_zdf_imp (trazdf.F90:118-293) builds the tridiagonal ONCE and reuses it: the build is guarded at :159-160 by (jn == jp_tem .OR. (jn == jp_sal .AND. ln_zdfddm)).  ln_zdfddm = F on GYRE (ocean.output:568), so SALINITY IS SOLVED WITH TEMPERATURE'S MATRIX and avs never enters.
read_before_measuring.r0_4: The matrix diffusivity is zwt = avt + ah_wslp2 (trazdf.F90:172-174), not avt alone.  l_ldfslp is TRUE because ldftra.F90:249 sets it for nldf_tra == np_lap_i, and GYRE resolves 'Rotated laplacian operator (standard)' (ocean.output:664) from ln_traldf_lap = T + ln_traldf_iso = T (:650, :655).  ln_traldf_msc = F (:657), so it is the ah_wslp2 arm at :172-174 and not the akz arm at :167-170.
read_before_measuring.r0_5: ln_zad_Aimp = F (ocean.output:553), so the diagonal build takes the ELSE arm at trazdf.F90:217-223 and carries no implicit-vertical-advection term.  ln_zdfmfc = F (:561), so neither the matrix block at :229-235 nor the RHS block at :265-269 runs.
read_before_measuring.r0_6: Under key_qco + key_vco_1d3d the thickness macros resolve DIFFERENTLY for T and W, and this is the single most likely transcription trap in the routine.  domzgr_substitute.h90:126 gives e3t(i,j,k,t) = e3t_3d(i,j,k)*(1+r3t(i,j,t)*tmask(i,j,k)) -- WITH the mask -- while :131 gives e3w(i,j,k,t) = e3w_1d(k)*(1+r3t(i,j,t)) -- NO mask, a ONE-DIMENSIONAL reference ladder, and r3t at the T point rather than any r3w.  Confirmed in the compiled ppsrc at BLD/ppsrc/nemo/trazdf.f90:230-233.
read_before_measuring.r0_7: ah_wslp2 and akz are PUBLIC module arrays of ldfslp (ldfslp.F90:65-66), allocated (jpi,jpj,jpk) at :571, and trazdf USEs ldfslp.  ah_wslp2 is written by traldf_iso_a33 (traldf_iso.F90:135, :296) inside the tra_ldf call that runs immediately before tra_zdf, so it is live at the write point.
read_before_measuring.r0_8: GYRE's initial density is HORIZONTALLY UNIFORM: usrdef_istate.F90:63 and :70 make T and S functions of pdept alone, and the card is zco with a flat bottom.  ldf_slp is called ONCE per step from the BEFORE state (stprk3.F90:193, CALL ldf_slp(kstp, rhd, rn2b, Nbb, Nbb)).  At kt=1 that BEFORE state is the initial state.
read_before_measuring.r0_9: GYRE's avt is a live closure output, not a constant: ln_zdftke = T and ln_zdfevd = T (ocean.output:557, :562), rn_avt0 = 1.2e-5.  It is the only field in the tracer matrix that a closure computes.
read_before_measuring.r0_10: legoESM's literal transcription is implicit_vertical_diffusion_nemo_tracer_pair in ocean/physics/vertical_mixing/implicit_solver.py, reached from the model's step at ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:10226 through implicit_vertical_diffusion_ocean_tracer_pair_dispatch(evaluation='nemo_literal').  Its three recurrences are _nemo_ordered_solve, the SAME function object the momentum solve uses.
read_before_measuring.r0_11: A tracer-side pre-implicit override EXISTS and was verified by reading it, not assumed: _NEMOWSRK3TestHooks.pre_implicit_tracer_override and .pre_implicit_tracer_content_override at ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:1271 and :1276, consumed at :7870-7881.  It is already used by nemo_testcase_l2_gyre_stage3_completion_gate.py:338.  This round does NOT need it: the gate drives the production solve function directly, which is the stronger form of Rule 10 and avoids the causal-injection arm round 34 recorded as broken.
read_before_measuring.r0_12: Round 34's exoneration of tra_ldf covers its increment to ts(Krhs) only.  ah_wslp2 enters the ZDF MATRIX and never touches Krhs, so 'tra_ldf contributes exactly 0' does not exonerate it.  That is why the instrument dumps it.

PR1.claim: Rebuilding zwi/zwd/zws, the LU diagonal zwt, the per-level RHS, the forward-sweep intermediate and the solved column from the record's OWN operands, by the statements at trazdf.F90:172-174, :204, :217-223, :256-261, :271-287 with the key_qco/key_vco_1d3d substitutions of domzgr_substitute.h90:126 and :131, reproduces every dumped array with ZERO cells bit-unequal on the writer's own [ntsi,ntei]x[ntsj,ntej] box.
PR1.threshold: 0 cells unequal on every rebuilt array
PR1.falsifier: any cell unequal -> one of the five resolved-branch readings (l_ldfslp, ln_traldf_msc, ln_zdfddm, ln_zad_Aimp, ln_zdfmfc) or one substitution is wrong, and NO number from this record may be quoted until it is fixed

PR2.arm: SWEEP -- legoESM's own ordered solve, given NEMO's exact matrix and NEMO's exact RHS
PR2.claim: The three recurrences legoESM runs, driven with the dumped zwi/zwd/zws and the dumped per-level RHS, reproduce NEMO's solved column BIT-EXACTLY for both tracers.
PR2.threshold: 0 cells unequal on T and on S
PR2.falsifier: DEBT on either tracer -> the SWEEP owns the 1.36e-12 and the fix is inside the recurrence, which would also put every momentum discharge that shares the same function under review

PR3.arm: ASSEMBLY -- legoESM's assembled lower/diagonal/upper, given NEMO's own operands
PR3.claim: Given NEMO's own face diffusivity, e3t(Kaa), e3w(Kmm), rDt and tmask read from the record, legoESM's assembly reproduces NEMO's zwi, zwd and zws bit-exactly, scored per diagonal.
PR3.threshold: 0 cells unequal on each of the three diagonals
PR3.falsifier: DEBT on any diagonal -> the ASSEMBLY FORMULA owns it, and the differing diagonal names the statement

PR4.claim: PR2 and PR3 both hold, so NEITHER the sweep NOR the assembly formula carries the 1.36e-12; the owner is an OPERAND legoESM computes for itself, or the RHS built from it.  Ranked first suspect: avt, the TKE+evd vertical diffusivity, the only closure output in the tracer matrix (r0_9).  Second: the RHS pair e3t(Kbb)*T(Kbb) + p2dt*e3t(Kmm)*T(Krhs).  Third: the e3t(Kaa) and e3w(Kmm) substitutions of r0_6.
PR4.threshold: PR2 and PR3 both at 0 cells unequal
PR4.falsifier: either PR2 or PR3 over the bar REFUTES this: the owner is then inside legoESM's transcription of the routine, not in its inputs

PR5.claim: ah_wslp2 is EXACTLY ZERO on every owned cell at kt=1 stage 3, because the slopes are built once per step from the BEFORE state (r0_8) and GYRE's initial density is horizontally uniform.  The fold is therefore INERT here and cannot own the residual, even though round 34's tra_ldf exoneration does not cover it (r0_12).
PR5.threshold: max |ah_wslp2| over owned cells is exactly 0.0
PR5.falsifier: any nonzero owned cell -> the fold IS live at kt=1, it becomes the ranked first operand suspect ahead of avt, and PR4's ranking is rewritten

PR6.claim: The clamp at trazdf.F90:89-91 changes NO cell on GYRE at kt=1: the pre-clamp solved S in this record equals the post-clamp S bit for bit.
PR6.threshold: 0 cells differ between the pre-clamp and post-clamp S
PR6.falsifier: any clamped cell -> the pre-clamp and post-clamp columns are different quantities and every earlier S comparison at this boundary is confounded, which is itself the finding

PR7.claim: Every gate arm has a plant that turns it red and exits non-zero, and the reader refuses a wrong record: bad magic, bad version, non-64-bit payload, a short record, a duplicated array, an extent that runs past EOF, trailing bytes, a non-finite payload, and a header whose ln_zdfddm or ln_zad_Aimp or ln_zdfmfc or ln_traldf_msc flag says the record was written by a branch the reader cannot score.
PR7.threshold: each plant exits non-zero; each malformed record gets a VERDICT rather than a traceback
PR7.falsifier: any plant passing, or any malformed record parsed as valid
